tools.name: resolveEnvironment
tools.description: Resolves which Mobiscroll framework and major version a project uses, from the contents of its package.json. This server runs remotely and has no access to the local filesystem, so the file contents are passed in as packageJsonContent. Returns the framework and major version that the other tools in this server take as arguments.

packageJsonContent.description: REQUIRED (raw file text). The full raw content of the project's package.json - the repository root, or the nearest one above the file you are editing. Read the file from the workspace and pass its content here. In a monorepo, use the package.json that declares the @mobiscroll/* dependency.

framework.description: Only for the no-package.json path, and only together with noPackageJsonReason. Do NOT use this to skip reading an existing package.json - passing framework without noPackageJsonReason is rejected.

noPackageJsonReason.description: Set ONLY after searching the workspace and confirming NO package.json exists (repo root or any parent of the edited file). 'cdn' = Mobiscroll loaded via a script tag; 'no-package-json-found-after-search' = you searched and found none. Required (with framework) to use the no-package.json path.

tools.name: listComponents
tools.description: Returns all available Mobiscroll UI components for a given framework and major version, with a short description and entity count for each.

framework.description: Framework to list components for. Use "js" for plain JavaScript (@mobiscroll/javascript package).

tools.name: getComponentSchema
tools.description: Returns the API schema (options, events, methods, renderers) for a Mobiscroll component. Two-step, token-efficient flow: (1) call WITHOUT names to get a compact index - every entity as name + kind + tsType + a one-line summary. (2) Review the index, then call AGAIN with names:[...] to get the full details (complete description, default value, related entities) for only the entities you will actually use. Optionally pass kind to narrow to one entity type. The full schema is large, so prefer this two-step flow over pulling everything. Deprecated entities are marked deprecated: true in the index, with their replacement in the summary; don't use them in new code.

component.description: Bare lowercase component ID, regardless of framework (e.g., "datepicker", "select", "popup"). Do NOT include framework-specific prefixes or casing - use "eventcalendar" not "mbsc-eventcalendar" (Angular), "MbscEventcalendar" (Vue), or "Eventcalendar" (React). For Eventcalendar, append the variant suffix: "eventcalendar.base", "eventcalendar.agenda", "eventcalendar.scheduler", "eventcalendar.timeline", "eventcalendar.calendarview". Use listComponents to discover valid IDs.

framework.description: Framework to get the schema for. Use "js" for plain JavaScript (@mobiscroll/javascript package).

names.description: Detail tier: entity names (as shown in the index) to return in full. Omit on the first call to get the compact index; then call again with the handful of names you need. Names not found are reported in query.notFound.

kind.description: Optional filter: return only entities of this kind. Works with or without names.

tools.name: searchExamples
tools.description: Search for Mobiscroll examples by query, framework, major version, and component filters. Supports multi-keyword queries — all keywords must match (AND logic). Results are sorted by relevance (title matches rank highest).

query.description: Search query — space-separated keywords, all must match (AND). Searches title, tags, component names, and description.

framework.description: Framework to search in. Use "js" for plain JavaScript (@mobiscroll/javascript package).

components.description: Filter by component. Pass the bare lowercase component IDs as returned by listComponents / getComponentSchema (e.g. "popup", "select", "input", "checkbox", "datepicker", "eventcalendar"). OR logic across the array. For Eventcalendar you may append a view suffix to narrow to that view - "eventcalendar.agenda", "eventcalendar.scheduler", "eventcalendar.timeline", "eventcalendar.calendarview"; bare "eventcalendar" (or "eventcalendar.base") returns all views.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20). Applies to every filter combination - component-only, query-only, or both. The response reports "total" (matches before the cap) and "returned"; raise maxResults to fetch more.

tools.name: getExampleById
tools.description: Get a complete example by ID, including source files, description, and implementation instructions (when available). The ID of a retired example returns the example that replaces it, with redirectedFrom and a notice.

framework.description: Framework of the example. Use "js" for plain JavaScript (@mobiscroll/javascript package).

tools.name: validateCode
tools.description: Validate a code snippet against the component schema, checking for unknown props/events/methods and deprecated usage. Static analysis only — no execution.

component.description: Bare lowercase component ID, regardless of framework (e.g., "datepicker", "select", "popup"). Do NOT include framework-specific prefixes or casing — use "eventcalendar" not "mbsc-eventcalendar" (Angular), "MbscEventcalendar" (Vue), or "Eventcalendar" (React). For Eventcalendar, append the variant suffix: "eventcalendar.base", "eventcalendar.agenda", "eventcalendar.scheduler", "eventcalendar.timeline", "eventcalendar.calendarview". Use listComponents to discover valid IDs.

framework.description: Framework of the snippet. Use "js" for plain JavaScript (@mobiscroll/javascript package).

tools.name: resolveConnectEnvironment
tools.description: Resolves which Mobiscroll Connect SDK (language and version) a project depends on, from the contents of its dependency manifest, and returns the Connect API and SDK versions this server documents. This server runs remotely and has no access to the local filesystem, so the manifest contents are passed in as manifestContent.

manifestContent.description: Raw content of the project dependency manifest: package.json, pyproject.toml, composer.json, *.csproj, pom.xml, go.mod, or Gemfile. Read the file from the workspace and pass its content here.

tools.name: listConnectEndpoints
tools.description: Lists all Mobiscroll Connect REST API endpoints (method, path, summary, auth): OAuth (authorize, token, connection status, disconnect, revoke), calendars, events, webhook subscriptions and the webhook public keys. Also lists "webhook-delivery" (kind "webhook-delivery"): not an endpoint you call but the signed request Connect sends to your webhook URL. Returns the conventions that hold for every endpoint (401 and error body shapes, rate limits). Use getConnectEndpointSchema for full parameter/response detail of one endpoint, getConnectModel for body shapes and getConnectGuide for concepts.

tools.name: getConnectEndpointSchema
tools.description: Returns the full schema of a single Connect REST endpoint: method, path, parameters (query/body/header) with types, authentication, response statuses and bodies, response headers, per-provider behavior, notes, and examples. Resolve by endpointId (from listConnectEndpoints) or by method + path (a full URL or a path with /api works too; a path alone that matches several methods returns the candidates). Describes the endpoint from documentation; does not call it. Documents the Mobiscroll Connect REST API: https://mobiscroll.com/docs/connect/api/overview

method.description: HTTP method, e.g. "GET". Use with path if endpointId is unknown.

path.description: Endpoint path, e.g. "/events" (relative to the API base; "/api/events" or a full URL also work).

tools.name: listConnectSdkMethods
tools.description: Lists the resources (client, auth, calendars, events, webhooks) and methods exposed by one language's Connect SDK; client holds the constructor and the token-refresh hook. Use getConnectSdkMethod for the full signature/doc of one method.

language.description: SDK language to list methods for.

tools.name: getConnectSdkMethod
tools.description: Returns the full schema of one SDK method in one language: signature, parameters, return type, doc comment, example, the SDK version that added it, notes, and the SDK types the signature uses (fields included). Identify the method by canonical id ("events.create", "client.constructor", "client.onTokensRefreshed"), by the language method name ("ListAsync"), or "resource.method". A helper that is not a client method (webhooks.verifyWebhookSignature) carries callAs. Python methods carry their async-client twin.

tools.name: searchConnect
tools.description: Keyword search across Connect REST endpoints, SDK methods, concept guides and data models. Space-separated keywords; common synonyms match (meeting -> conference, login -> authorize). Results matching every keyword come first; when none does, results matching some keywords are returned with match "partial" and the words nothing matched in unmatchedWords. Results sorted by relevance.

language.description: Restrict SDK matches to one language. Endpoints, guides and models are always searched.

tools.name: mapConnectEndpointToSdk
tools.description: Given a Connect REST endpoint, returns the equivalent SDK call (method name, signature, example, notes, the SDK version that added it) in each language. Resolve by endpointId or by method + path. Optionally restrict to one language. Describes the endpoint and SDK call from documentation; does not call either. Documents the Mobiscroll Connect REST API: https://mobiscroll.com/docs/connect/api/overview

method.description: HTTP method. Use with path if endpointId is unknown.

path.description: Endpoint path (relative to the API base; "/api/..." or a full URL also work).

tools.name: getConnectErrorTaxonomy
tools.description: Returns the shared Connect error taxonomy: each error category with its HTTP status, code, response body shape, when the SDKs raise it, whether retrying helps, the language-idiomatic exception type and its extra fields (accounts, retry-after, reason, ...), plus the rules that apply to every error (when the SDKs refresh the token). Optionally filter the per-language columns to one language.

language.description: Filter the per-language columns to one language.

tools.name: getConnectGuide
tools.description: Returns a Mobiscroll Connect concept guide, checked against the API and SDK source: token lifecycle and persistence, scopes and partial consent, paging, times and all-day events, event ids and recurring events, writing events, webhooks, errors and rate limits, disconnect vs revoke, the Connect pages, environments and limits, and a recipe for showing Connect events in a Mobiscroll Eventcalendar. Call without topic to list the guides.

topic.description: Guide topic id, e.g. "token-lifecycle". Omit to list every guide.

tools.name: getConnectModel
tools.description: Returns a Mobiscroll Connect data model: the JSON shape of an event, calendar, recurrence rule, conference data, events page, connection status, token response or webhook delivery, with field types, which fields are read-only or write-only, and per-provider differences. Call without name to list the models. For the SDK class of a model in one language use getConnectSdkMethod (types).

name.description: Model name, e.g. "CalendarEvent". Omit to list every model.
